description: This file defines the EmployeeSupervisorAPI class, which provides REST API endpoints for managing employee supervisor relationships in the OrangeHRM system. It includes methods for retrieving, listing, creating, updating, and deleting supervisor entries, along with validation rules and parameter handling. The class interacts with services and data access objects related to employee reporting methods and supervisor configurations.

classes.name: EmployeeSupervisorAPI
classes.description: A REST API controller managing supervisor relationships for employees, including endpoints for retrieval, listing, addition, update, and deletion of supervisor records.

methods.name: getOne
methods.description: Retrieves a specific supervisor record for an employee based on employee and supervisor IDs.

methods.name: getAll
methods.description: Lists all supervisor records for a specific employee, supporting sorting and pagination.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Creates a new supervisor relationship for an employee.

methods.name: setSupervisorParams
methods.description: Sets the attributes of a ReportTo object based on request parameters for supervisor creation.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Updates an existing supervisor record with new reporting method data.

methods.name: getUrlAttributes
methods.description: Extracts employee and supervisor IDs from URL parameters.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForGetOne
methods.description: Returns validation rules for retrieving a single supervisor record.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForGetAll
methods.description: Returns validation rules for listing supervisor records.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForCreate
methods.description: Returns validation rules for creating a supervisor record.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Deletes supervisor records for a specific employee based on provided IDs.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForDelete
methods.description: Returns validation rules for deleting supervisor records.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForUpdate
methods.description: Returns validation rules for updating supervisor records.

methods.name: getEmpNumberRule
methods.description: Constructs validation rule for employee number parameter.

methods.name: getReportingMethodIdRule
methods.description: Constructs validation rule for reporting method ID parameter.

methods.name: getSupervisorIdsRule
methods.description: Constructs validation rule for supervisor IDs array parameter.
